mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1000 units, coupled with rising GDP (GDPC1), indicates strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or correlation between HOUST and GDPC1 falls below 0.4 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2% signals accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5%, combined with increasing payroll employment (PAYEMS), indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or correlation between UNRATE and PAYEMS falls below 0.5 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 110, signaling strengthening supply chains, leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns following INDPRO increases are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) above $380 billion, indicating strong consumer spending, drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or RSAFS growth falls below 3% YoY over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid 50bps increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) within a month signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 45% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or FEDFUNDS increases are not followed by significant SPX declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A stagnant unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5%, combined with sluggish payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth below 100k, indicates labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or correlation between UNRATE and PAYEMS growth falls below 0.4 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 900 units, signaling weakening demand, leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns following HOUST declines are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).
